findings.observation: The heart-shaped face, warm brown skin, and left-cheek mole remain legible, but enlarged round doll-like eyes and smoothed youthful facial planes replace the source’s mature close-set eye shape and weaken the intended 38-year-old identity.
The compact chibi body loses the source’s clearly muscular shoulder and forearm construction and reads as a generic slight build rather than a compact muscular adult.
Both arms and empty hands are fully visible, proportionate to the compact adult body, and avoid inflated fists or forearms.
The violet-plum asymmetrical split-length hair is preserved, with long loose hair on one side and the braided close-cropped side clearly readable.

The lilac-smoke draped robe, high collar, visible mending, uneven hems, repaired cuff with bright thread, and compact finger-line tattoo confined to the fingers are preserved without earrings or undeclared extra detail.
The head-plus-hair height is approximately 35% of the full figure, within the required 32–36% band.
The complete figure is shown head to toe with both feet, hair tips, sleeves, and robe hems inside the frame.
A low forward-leaning empty-hand stance with bent knees and guarded arms reads immediately as a combat-ready pose at game scale.
The restrained mended robe, empty hands, plain parchment background, and absence of weapons, magic, glow, UI, text, badges, or ornate effects stay within the one-star rarity ceiling.

attempts.retryReason: A new target version should restore the source’s mature close-set eye shape and 38-year-old facial cues, and clearly muscular shoulder and forearm construction, while preserving the passing 35% ratio, exact details, hair, robe, framing, combat stance, and one-star ceiling.
